hypothesis: The fixed workload has approximately constant empty-search cost except for the ten- and eleven-token observations. These indicators test that empirical distinction; prompt length may be a proxy for initialization effects rather than their cause.

pcvs.name: request_tokens
pcvs.rationale: Retains eight distinct observed prompt-length states and models the baseline length dependence.

pcvs.name: ten_token_prompt
pcvs.rationale: Separates the observed ten-token state, whose instruction cost was substantially above baseline.

pcvs.name: eleven_token_prompt
pcvs.rationale: Separates the other observed high-cost short-prompt state.
